name: high-utility-low-offense
category: pool with one high-utility low-offense mon
notes: Eleven functional attackers plus Shuckle: the canonical high-utility low-offense body (base 10 offenses, no evolution to rescue it). Utility roles are gated by the non-passive floor and weighted below attacker roles, so a mon that cannot threaten anything must not displace a real attacker in a PvE team. (Originally used Cottonee, but the evolution-requirements engine correctly legalized Sun-Stone Whimsicott — a real fast-utility mon — which is allowed to compete.)
